## Appearance

Diana is described as a very pretty little girl with rosy or crimson cheeks. She has her mother's black eyes and glossy, jet-black hair that falls in curls, as well as a merry expression inherited from her father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Personality

Diana is a good, smart, and ladylike individual with a merry expression. Known for her practical nature, she possesses talent as a singer and is widely recognized for her notable taste in dressing.

## History

Named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born, Diana Barry lived at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) when she first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two quickly formed a deep friendship and pledged to be bosom friends forever. Their bond faced an early trial when Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) temporarily forbade Diana from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but they were allowed to resume their friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from severe croup. Diana remained Anne's constant companion through their school years, joining her in forming a story club and sharing secret notes. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the island in her entrance examinations, Diana rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper to deliver the news. Together, they canvassed for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), took woodland walks to hidden places like [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden and [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), and navigated local mishaps. Though distress settled over Diana when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepared to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she assured [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of her steadfast affection. Shortly before assisting with Miss Lavendar's garden wedding, Diana got engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> "I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became fast friends after meeting at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), swearing a solemn oath to be bosom companions forever. They frequently row on the pond, walk to school together, and support each other through various childhood mishaps and milestones. Their bond is exceptionally deep, surviving temporary separations imposed by adults as well as Anne's academic pursuits.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--gilbert-blythe.md)

Diana maintains a friendly relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), acting as a peacemaker between him and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during their long-standing academic rivalry. Diana also celebrates shared accomplishments with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and participates in community events with him.
